credits.title: ENE Repeat
credits.overview: A close-knit group of friends embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.

credits.title: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
credits.overview: A deadly countdown begins when strangers receive an ultimatum: escape before 10 a.m. tomorrow or face catastrophic consequences. With hours ticking away, survival depends on outrunning an escalating threat.

credits.title: Mana ShankaraVaraPrasad Garu
credits.overview: National security officer Vara Prasad, protecting his estranged wife and kids from a vengeful ex-cop, sees it as a chance to rebuild their relationship after six years apart.

credits.title: Santhana Prapthirasthu
credits.overview: A journey of facing life’s twists & tests with laughter and love!

credits.title: Sundarakanda
credits.overview: A man born under the Mula Nakshatra faces misfortune and failed relationships, exploring his journey to win over his ideal match.

credits.title: My Dear Donga
credits.overview: A thief breaks into a lone young woman's home. But when he arrives to steal, the woman catches him and threatens him to throw him over to the cops. The thief then extends his hand for a friendship with her, but not without hurdles.

credits.title: Operation Valentine
credits.overview: Showcasing the indomitable spirits of the Indian Air Force heroes on the frontlines and the challenges they face during one of the biggest, fiercest aerial attacks that India has ever seen.

credits.title: Masthu Shades Unnai Ra
credits.overview: Manu, an artist, is on a mission to get noticed again after advanced printing technology shows up and steals his spotlight. He's trying out modern tricks to be more efficient. Will he make it?

credits.title: Kismat
credits.overview: An easy life of three seemingly ordinary, jobless engineers from a small village goes haywire as they try to hide an unwelcome money heist leaving only honesty on their side.

credits.title: Miss. Shetty Mr. Polishetty
credits.overview: Miss Shetty is a feminist living in London and wants to be single forever. Mr. Polishetty from Hyderabad in Telangana, India, wants to be in a committed relationship. The two appear to be in different stages of life but somehow connect.

credits.title: Gandeevadhari Arjuna
credits.overview: Ex-special forces officer turned Private security bodyguard Arjun Varma, agrees to protect Central Environment Minister Adtiya Raj Bahadur while he’s in London for a Climate Change Conference at the UN. But a series of events force him to protect much more than his client.

credits.title: Spy
credits.overview: A RAW agent is in search of his brother’s killer, unravels the connection between a notorious arms dealer and the hidden secrets of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose, risking everything to protect India from impending chaos.

credits.title: Virupaksha
credits.overview: Set in a village named Rudravanam in 1990's, Surya along with his mother, visit there after a long time. Suddenly a series of mysterious deaths occur due to an unknown person's occult practice and whole village is scared. Will Surya find the person causing the deaths and save the village?

credits.title: Shekar
credits.overview: An alcoholic ex-cop lives a somewhat peaceful life with his pampered daughter. An unfortunate incident forces him to lead an investigation again.

credits.title: Sehari
credits.overview: Varun who leads a joyful life with his girlfriend, until he breaks up with her. In anger, he takes a senseless decision to enter next phase of life by entering wedlock. But he realizes that she is not the right choice after becoming close with his fiancée’s elder sister.

credits.title: Shyam Singha Roy
credits.overview: A young filmmaker is in a soup right when he’s about to find his footing in the film industry. When he sets out to find an answer, turns out it’s in the past.

credits.title: Ichata Vahanamulu Nilupa Radu
credits.overview: A young man working in an architecture firm falls for his intern. As romance blossoms, in a bid to surprise her, he accidentally enters a crime scene. How he gets out of being framed for it forms the tale.

credits.title: Rang De
credits.overview: Arjun detests Anu because she has always stolen his thunder ever since she step foot in their colony years ago. Will he ever find it in his heart to love her like she loves him?

credits.title: Meeku Maathrame Cheptha
credits.overview: Rakesh, in an effort to impress his fiance, he promised her that he has no bad habits.  But when a compromising video of his leaks just two days before his wedding, all hell breaks loose.

credits.title: Jessie
credits.overview: Set in an abandoned house, the film follows a team of professional ghost hunters trying to conduct a paranormal investigation to unveil the mystery of two sisters, Jessie and Amy, where Amy shows unusual mental and physical behaviour.

credits.title: Ee Nagaraniki Emaindi?
credits.overview: Four friends, with a bittersweet history, get drunk and embark on a journey to Goa. On the trip, they lose an expensive ring which threatens to derail one of their engagement. They end up confronting one another and their own fears, as they enroll in a short film making competition in Goa to try and win the prize money

credits.title: Malli Raava
credits.overview: Karthik and Anjali are childhood sweethearts who fell in love when they're fourteen. Despite having immense love for each other, circumstances forced them apart many a time. Will things change when they grow older? Will their love story finally have a happy ending?

credits.title: Artificial
credits.overview: A 2012 Telugu short film.
